> Quick notes:
> - We've seen Google calendars occasionally strip Meet links for external guests when organizer domain settings or calendar forwarding rules interfere.

Two quick technical workarounds we've used successfully:
1) Create a plain-text calendar event (not auto-converted by GSuite) that includes the Zoom URL in the event description and send as an .ics attachment. That prevents Meet auto-injection.
2) Alternatively, a forwarded invite from an organizer on a consumer Gmail account often retains the join link for guests — but that's a little hacky for enterprise customers.

I'm attaching a prepared ICS (redwood_zoom_fallback.ics) that contains a Zoom join URL and dial-in notes. If Soojin/Marissa want, I can regenerate the event and send it from my calendar so we have a fresh organizer record.
